title: MapSpec v1
description: Intermediate data model consumed by build-html.mjs and render.js. Authoritative definition; conflicts with prose resolved in favor of this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Top-level only. Fixed to 1 for first version.

nodes.description: Flowchart only (diagramKind is flowchart or omitted). Hard cap 100; soft cap 60 (skill prompts user to narrow scope above soft cap).

edges.description: Flowchart only. Forbidden when meta.diagramKind is sequence.

participants.description: Sequence only. Declaration order is the lifeline order from left to right.

messages.description: Sequence only. Array order (depth-first after frame expansion) is the message order. Soft cap 30, hard cap 60 counted over the recursively expanded declared messages.

claimState.description: Assertion-level state for a node/edge. verified requires ALL evidence.state=verified and >=1 inspected code or document location; inferred has mixed evidence or strong-but-unproven; unconfirmed has no verified evidence.

uiLocale.description: Optional fixed renderer UI locale. Use the conversation/output locale; default to English when omitted.

summary.description: Panorama summary. Non-empty (v3.2.14: aligned with validator and design intent).

diagramKind.description: Optional diagram family. flowchart is the default and keeps nodes/edges; sequence requires participants/messages and forbids nodes/edges. layoutDirection/layoutBands only apply to flowchart.

layoutDirection.description: Optional macro flow direction. TD is the default; LR is for business flows whose main stages should progress left to right.

layoutBands.description: Optional semantic phase bands for a balanced multi-row business flow. Each node subgraph must appear in exactly one band. Bands use the outer TD direction; their own direction controls the left/right reading order.

id.description: Stable id, usable as Mermaid node id, globally unique.

labelKind.description: Optional relationship-label semantics. action is the default; condition renders as a condition badge rather than a directional action label.

id.description: Stable id shared by MapSpec, selection keys and detail views. The DSL generator deterministically maps it to an internal safe id (icm_pN); values that collide with sequence syntax keywords stay legal here.

title.description: Single-line display name shown next to the lifeline. Length counts Unicode code points (hard cap 100; soft cap handled by the skill workflow). Newlines are rejected because a newline after `as` would inject a new DSL statement.

from.description: Declared participant id. Self-messages allow from == to.

label.description: Single-line message text. Length counts Unicode code points (soft cap 40, hard cap 100); content beyond the soft cap moves into detail. Newlines are rejected because multi-line messages split the mapped text block and break the record mapping.

arrowKind.description: solid (default) is a call/initiation; dashed is a response/return.

activatesTo.description: Activate the `to` participant with this message (Mermaid `+`). Forbidden inside frames and when deactivatesFrom is also true.

deactivatesFrom.description: Deactivate the `from` participant with this message (Mermaid `-`). Forbidden inside frames and when activatesTo is also true.

activation.description: Optional inline activation change. Both booleans true is rejected; messages inside frames must not carry activation at all. Pairing is validated linearly over declaration order (outer activation may wrap whole frames).

frame.description: Discriminator separating frames from messages in the mixed messages array.

label.description: Frame condition for loop/opt, rendered as plain text. The character contract rejects & ; # < > " $ : % and newlines: entities get shredded by narrow-frame wrapping, $ triggers math rendering, : is consumed by wrap:/nowrap: control prefixes, % is deleted by Mermaid directive preprocessing, and newlines inject DSL statements. alt never reads this field: its branch conditions come from the respective branches[].label.

branches.description: alt only: mutually exclusive branches rendered with else.

label.description: Branch condition, subject to the same plain-text character contract as frame labels.

then.description: verified evidence must carry a concrete code or document location with an inspected line range.

path.description: Relative path only. Regex rejects: empty, absolute (/), drive letters (C:\), UNC (\\). Segment-level rules (no '..' or '.' segments, no backslashes anywhere) and acceptance test vectors live in mapspec-v1.build-rules.json, enforced by build-html.mjs unit tests (not by JSON Schema).
path.$comment: Schema intentionally stays clean of custom keywords so ajv strict mode compiles it without 'unknown keyword' errors. Segment-level path rejection cannot be expressed in regex; see mapspec-v1.build-rules.json pathValidation.acceptanceTestVectors.

evidence.$comment: lineEnd>=lineStart enforcement and path segment checks live in mapspec-v1.build-rules.json, enforced by build-html.mjs (not JSON Schema).

segment.$comment: Code excerpt caps: at most 80 rows and 500 characters per cell. The 12,000-character per-segment total is enforced by the zero-dependency runtime validator because JSON Schema cannot sum nested string lengths.
